Elise (Partner AM): Heads up — Nebula One wants to run a 60–90 day joint POC. Main asks: telemetry export at ~500 TPS, tenant isolation, and an entitlement model for channel billing. Also want guidance on whether to run on Redwood Hosted or Dedicated pilot. Any blockers?
Jordan (SE): Are they planning to push telemetry from their agent into our ingest endpoint, or do they want an on-prem collector that forwards? cloud+edge architecture matters for cost.
Elise (Partner AM): They preferred forwarding from their cloud agent (Azure eu-west). They mentioned wanting VNet peering or private link for security.
Alex Chen: For 500 TPS we can do hosted but need autoscaling and prefix/KV caching tuning. Dedicated gives more predictable latency and easier quota increases. Quick trade: hosted = faster setup + credits; dedicated = commit + reserved capacity.
Sanjay Rao: Network notes: we support Azure Private Link and VNet peering. For peering we need their subscription ID, tenant ID, and a /26 CIDR for endpoints. Also: default ingest quota is 100 TPS/tenant — we can raise to 500 with a dedicated pool or burst policy.
Maya Patel: Security checklist: we need completed security questionnaire, SOC2 report, TLS mutual auth for private link (optional), and if they want HSM-backed keys we need KMS details. Also SCIM for user sync or SAML SSO for admin portal?
Elise (Partner AM): They prefer SAML SSO + SCIM, and asked if we can store customer keys in their HSM via KMIP/HSM integr.
Priya K: Pricing: for a 60–90d pilot we can offer hosted credits up to $15k + 20% partner co-sell credit. Dedicated pilot requires a minimum monthly commit (approx $6k/mo) for the capacity they want. Channel uplift/discounts: standard co-sell 10% off list, can be negotiated if they commit to GA.
Jordan (SE): Implementation snippet for partner-forwarding (example):
```
# partner agent config
REDWOOD_INGEST=https://ingest.redwood.example/v1/events
API_KEY=partner-poc-token-XXX
BATCH_SIZE=256
CONCURRENCY=8
```
This should get them started; we should also validate TLS mTLS cert exchange if using private link.
Sanjay Rao: Ops checklist: 1) Provide Azure subscription + CIDR, 2) Confirm peering vs Private Link, 3) Request quota increase with expected TPS window and burst profile, 4) Provide sample payload size distribution.
Maya Patel: I'll email the security questionnaire template. Quick heads-up: they'll need to fill encryption-at-rest details, data retention, and access control. If they want client-side encryption keys in their KMS, we need an integration design doc.
Elise (Partner AM): Can someone draft a POC runbook (network steps, token provisioning, telemetry test plan, success metrics) and a ballpark cost estimate? Need it before EOW.
Jordan (SE): I can draft the runbook. I'll add sample curl/ingest tests and a telemetry validator script.
Sanjay Rao: I'll draft the network and quota sections + required Azure artifacts.
Priya K: I'll produce a short cost estimate table (hosted credits vs dedicated commit) and invoice flow for partner billing.
Elise (Partner AM): Amazing — tagging next steps: Jordan (runbook), Sanjay (network/quota), Priya (pricing), Maya (sec questionnaire). I'll coordinate with Nebula on timelines.
